archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified with Deep Violet Tech Sidebar

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, prioritize dense packing for dashboard (p-4, p-6)
layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gap-4
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton with 1px borders and sharp corners.

cards.style: Flat, 1px solid border-zinc-200, rounded-none or rounded-sm, no drop shadow

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-950 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

tables.style: Dense tabular layout, sticky headers, 1px bottom border on rows, hover:bg-zinc-50

tabs.style: Underline style or solid technical blocks, no pill-shaped tabs.

modals.style: Sharp corners, backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40, stark white surface
modals.layout: Grid-based forms inside modals (2 columns for desktop to separate Clinic Data and Admin Data)

login_background.description: Abstract flowing shape with purple and blue highlights - Use as subtle blend mode background for login screen.

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-150 ease-out
motion.hover: Color and border shifts only, avoid heavy transforms in the dashboard

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark purple sidebar requires white text for active states.
accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, tabs, modal triggers, and form inputs MUST have data-testid attributes.

key_views.dashboard: 4 KPI Cards (grid-cols-4), Recent Clinics Table spanning full width below.
key_views.clinic_management: List view with filters. Create Clinic action opens a large Dialog or navigates to a split-screen creation form (Clinic Details | Admin Details).
key_views.catalogs: Tabs interface (Medicamentos, Estudios, CIE-10). Each tab contains a datatable with inline edit or rapid-add rows.
key_views.user_management: Datatable of users. Row actions via dropdown (Role, Deactivate, Reset Password).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use IBM Plex Sans for all text. Install via Google Fonts.
Sidebar MUST be dark purple (#120B29) to satisfy the 'Aspecto tecnológico / Sidebar oscuro/morado' requirement. Content area must be light (#FAFAFA) for dashboard readability.
Implement Shadcn UI for standard components (Table, Dialog, Tabs, DropdownMenu).
Keep border-radius tight (rounded-sm or rounded-none) for a technical 'Control Room' feel.
Ensure the Create Clinic flow explicitly collects both Clinic Data and Initial Admin Data in a single robust form/modal.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements for testing.
Remember to output React code using .js/.jsx extensions as requested, not .tsx.
